blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — A magnitude 5.1 earthquake that struck Antique on Wednesday morning prompted the suspension of classes in several Iloilo municipalities and the evacuation of students, government employees, and people transacting in public offices. Authorities ordered the evacuation as they began inspections of buildings for possible structural damage. Based on the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs)’ initial bulletin, the earthquake occurred at 7:29 a.m., with its epicenter located 14 kilometers southeast of Valderrama, Antique, at a depth of 10 kilometers. The earthquake was felt across Western Visayas and parts of the Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, and Romblon. […]...
